cloudSync.reauthInstructions: Run this on the host, then restart the container.
cloudSync.disabledReason: Cloud sync is turned off for this drive in Addon policy, so nothing is uploaded.
cloudSync.sourceEmptyInstructions: Nothing was synced. Check that the drive is mounted and that the folder exists, then try again.
cloudSync.deleteLimitInstructions: The sync stopped because more files than the deletion limit were due to be deleted from the remote. Check that the drive is mounted. If the deletions are expected, raise Max deletions per sync in the Cloud Sync settings and run it again.
cloudSync.notSetUp: Cloud Sync is not set up yet.

cloudSyncSettings.title: Cloud Sync
cloudSyncSettings.description: Mirror drives, or folders inside them, to rclone remotes. A file deleted here is deleted from the remote on the next sync.
cloudSyncSettings.loadFailed: Could not load the Cloud Sync settings.
cloudSyncSettings.invalidSaved: The saved settings could not be read: {error}. Saving will replace them.
cloudSyncSettings.noRemotes: No rclone remotes are visible to Litloft. Create one on the host with rclone config and mount the rclone config into the backend.
cloudSyncSettings.maxDeleteHelp: A sync stops once it has deleted this many files from the remote.
cloudSyncSettings.drivesRestartNote: A drive added or renamed in Drives appears here after the backend restarts.
